body:
So I added a geo-search recipe to show how you can update search parameters and synchronize the URL. I also updated the search parameters guide.

This geo search example is very basic and only feature:

* a regular search through the searchbox.
* a map that when we click somewhere perform a new search.

We still need to do #1860 because with this example:

* the search is not triggered when moving the map. (mostly because I didn't find a `dragEnd` event with the lib used at the moment).
* No autocomplete.
